description.text: An expansion pack of the Pokémon Card Game series, released on 1 July 2004, with Deoxys on the pack. Its themes are the films Destiny Deoxys and Jirachi: Wish Maker, and it is full of Pokémon with strong Poké-Bodies and Poké-Powers. From around this set, Pokémon ☆ (Star) cards became a hidden card in each expansion; here they are Latias, Latios and Rayquaza. The cards are numbered to 82. In English it became EX Deoxys in February 2005.
